about_the_game:
————————————————————————————————————————————————

"Love to Live" is a romance-adventure visual novel where your heart and your life are both on the line.

As a "Dreamer," you are thrust into perilous nightmare realms.

To escape, you must fight side-by-side with three distinct heroes, making crucial choices that determine your fate. Beyond the pulse-pounding romance lies a hidden truth waiting to be unveiled...

["This time, let's never part again."]

I was chasing a shadow, only to stumble into a deadly game world...

【Welcome to the Dream Game】Escape to live, or fail and succumb to eternal slumber.

But fear not, for destiny has brought you companions:

The edgy Toy Designer CEO, the 'Prince Charming' junior from overseas, the cold Heir to a mystical clan, and...

Echoing bells, distant memories of past lives, and a mysterious peach wood branch...

What is the secret of this game? And what is the truth behind my own identity?

【3 Unique Character Routes, 3 Distinct Dream Stages!】

<Dreamscape I: Destiny Village>

The annual "Red Thread Festival" has arrived in Destiny Village!

Selected as a "lucky tourist" by a travel agency, you’re invited to explore this secluded mountain hamlet.

Step inside and experience the festivities... but what secrets lie beneath the vibrant celebration?

<Dreamscape II: Memory Land>

A joyful kingdom crafted by a lonely King—a dreamlike paradise where lost memories can be found!

Team up with your partner to clear the stages.

It’s all fun and games, but whatever you do, don't forget the way back home.

<Dreamscape III: Love & Charity Hospital No. 4>

Plague outbreak!

As a volunteer, you arrive at Hospital No. 4, where staff and resources are at a breaking point.

With the shadows of despair looming over the wards, how will you help the doctors and patients survive this crisis?

(Notice: Please ensure your own safety at all costs!)

Chairman of the Gu Group.

A whimsical CEO with a mischievous streak, he lives for anything that piques his interest.

Lately, he’s found work to be quite "amusing," transforming himself into an "atypical workaholic."

Who would have thought a man like him would keep priceless gemstones and cheap glass beads in the same box?

Driven by this eccentric hobby, he established his own designer toy brand, "Huaiyu Cosmo."

His age? That’s a secret, a secret...

The current Head of a legendary clan of Mystic Masters.

Having inherited the spiritual essence of the first patriarch, he is hailed as a "once-in-a-millennium" genius.

However, this gift is also a curse;

he is haunted by nightmares of the first Master’s karmic tribulations from a thousand years ago.

Laconic, stern, and indifferent. His ability to handle romantic situations is... absolute zero!

His family estate is tucked away in the mountains, where they run premium wellness industries.

Why not take a break at his private hot spring resort, the "Yangxin Pavilion"?

Your childhood friend and younger neighbor—a "clingy" boy just one year your junior.

Thanks to his mixed heritage, he’s always been the school’s golden boy, a true "Prince Charming."

He was never far from your side,

until high school when his father whisked him away to an ancestral estate in England, severing your connection.

Unable to bear the longing for his favorite "big sister," he fought for an exchange student slot...

and now, your little shadow is finally back!

The "older brother" who grew up in your home.

At age eight, he was the sole survivor of a tragic mountain road accident that claimed his parents.

As family friends, your parents took him in.

Ever since, he has been your reliable protector—the brother who could never say no to you.

Now a world-renowned photographer, his work takes him across the globe, and he only returns for fleeting visits.

He should be the person you know best,yet as he stands before you now……

Why does he feel like a total stranger?

【Unlock a Gallery of Stunning Original CGs!】

From a protective hand in the face of death to a tender embrace under the stars,

every heart-pounding moment is frozen in time.

Step into the recurring dreamscape to reclaim your memories and collect sweet, unforgettable moments with 'him'.

【Interactive Exploration — Level Up Your Immersion!】

Venture into unknown environments,

and investigate firsthand to uncover the chilling truths hidden within the Dream Game!

【Branching Storylines — Your Choice, Your Fate!】

Speak your mind and forge your own path!

The ultimate conclusion remains a mystery until your very last step...

(Note: Certain choices lead to vast branching scenarios.

We highly recommend using the Save function to explore every possibility! ❤️)

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains content that may not be suitable for all ages. It features mild jump scares, moderate intimate moments, discreet nudity, and non-bloody combat. These mature elements are consistently presented in a subtle or suggestive manner, without explicit detail.

short_description: Trapped in a game of dreams, where the price of failing to escape is eternal slumber. Across shifting worlds, you meet 'him.' Is he merely a kindred spirit born of crisis, or a forgotten soul from your distant memories? A heart-pounding romance adventure across the dreamscape—begins now!
